name: scRegulate
method_summary: scRegulate infers transcription factor activity and weighted TF-target GRNs from scRNA-seq data with a prior-guided variational autoencoder. The model embeds curated TF-target priors into the decoder GRN layer, progressively relaxes prior constraints during training, and fine-tunes GRN weights per cell type or cluster for context-specific regulation.

threading.upstream_mapping: scRegulate exposes no public n_jobs, worker or DataLoader num_workers argument through train_model() or fine_tune_clusters(); create_dataloader() hard-codes num_workers=0 unless called directly. The selected runtime is PyTorch/NumPy based, so the wrapper should map ANDREA --threads to torch.set_num_threads(threads), keep torch inter-op threads at 1, and set OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS, BLIS_NUM_THREADS and VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS before invoking scRegulate.

compatibility_rules.message: scRegulate train_model() performs a train/validation split and requires at least two expression columns.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_human uses a human CollecTRI prior and is only compatible with animal datasets or datasets with unknown taxonomy.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_mouse uses a mouse CollecTRI prior and is only compatible with animal datasets or datasets with unknown taxonomy.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_human uses Homo sapiens TF-target resources; choose collectri_mouse or provided_prior for other declared taxa.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_mouse uses Mus musculus TF-target resources; choose collectri_human or provided_prior for other declared taxa.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_human expects expression gene ids compatible with human CollecTRI symbols; the dataset taxon is unknown.
scRegulate prior_source=collectri_mouse expects expression gene ids compatible with mouse CollecTRI symbols; the dataset taxon is unknown.

conditional_required.message: prior_grn is required when prior_source=provided_prior because scRegulate train_model() requires a TF-target prior network as its net argument.
conditional_required.usage: The wrapper maps normalized prior_grn.tsv source, target and score columns to scRegulate's source, target and weight net DataFrame, preserving public gene identifiers and using signed scores as prior weights.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_native because scRegulate fine_tune_clusters() consumes cluster annotations to produce cluster-specific GRNs.
conditional_required.usage: The wrapper stores groups.tsv labels in AnnData.obs and passes that column as cluster_key to fine_tune_clusters(); exported network.csv contexts use the original public group ids as group:<id>.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions the dataset by group before running the global scRegulate path independently per group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one scRegulate child run per group. Each child follows the global train_model()+fine_tune_clusters(cluster_key=None) path; the wrapper accepts a full parent groups.tsv or a subset matching the current expression matrix, subsets it to the current expression columns, and uses it only to assign public group:<id> contexts.

progress.note: train_model() and fine_tune_clusters() both run explicit epoch loops and log epoch summaries at configurable intervals. The wrapper reports coarse lifecycle phases in progress.json and preserves upstream training/fine-tuning epoch diagnostics in scregulate.log.

prior_source.description: Source of the TF-target prior passed to scRegulate as net: bundled CollecTRI human, bundled CollecTRI mouse, or a user-provided normalized prior_grn.tsv.

epochs.description: Total epochs passed to train_model(). Upstream scRegulate 1.0.1 source default is 2000.

freeze_epochs.description: Epoch count used by train_model() for gradually applying the prior mask. The wrapper uses a minimum of 20 because upstream schedule_mask_factor divides by freeze_epochs // 20.

train_val_split_ratio.description: Fraction of cells assigned to the training split in train_model(); the remaining cells are validation cells. Upstream source default is 0.8.

batch_size.description: Batch size passed to train_model() and ULM. Use null to preserve scRegulate's data-dependent rule batch_size=int(train_val_split_ratio * n_cells).

oneOf.description: Use null so the wrapper passes batch_size=None and scRegulate computes int(train_val_split_ratio * n_cells).

learning_rate.description: Adam learning rate passed to train_model(). Upstream source default is 2.5e-4.

alpha_max.description: Maximum alpha for the transition from prior-driven ULM TF estimates to data-driven VAE TF activity in train_model().

alpha_scale.description: Increment scale used by train_model() when validation loss improves and alpha is increased toward alpha_max.

beta_max.description: Maximum KL-divergence weight scheduled during train_model().

gamma_max.description: Maximum L1 GRN-mask regularization weight scheduled during train_model().

early_stopping_patience.description: train_model() early-stopping patience in epochs after alpha reaches its maximum.

min_targets.description: Minimum number of target genes per TF. The wrapper first drops prior TFs with fewer than this many distinct targets to keep scRegulate's adapt_prior_and_data() and ULM filters aligned for weighted priors, then passes the same value to train_model(). Upstream 1.0.1 source default is 20, although paper text and tutorial examples often use 10.

min_TFs.description: Minimum number of TFs per target gene retained from the prior by adapt_prior_and_data().

fine_tune_epochs.description: Epoch budget passed to fine_tune_clusters(). In group_native mode scRegulate scales the actual epochs for each cluster as max(fine_tune_min_epochs, int(fine_tune_epochs * cluster_size / total_cells)).

fine_tune_min_epochs.description: Minimum epochs per cluster passed to fine_tune_clusters(); relevant when execution.mode=group_native.

fine_tune_beta_max.description: Maximum beta warm-up value passed to fine_tune_clusters().

fine_tune_max_weight_norm.description: Absolute clipping bound for fine_tune_clusters() tf_mapping weights.

random_state.description: Seed passed to train_model(random_state=...) for reproducible train/validation splitting and PyTorch/NumPy random seeds.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined wrapper and scRegulate training/fine-tuning log.
Resolved scRegulate parameters, prior source, expression preprocessing, prior min_targets filter summary, expression dimensions, execution mode and runtime thread mapping.
TF-target prior network actually passed to scRegulate after loading CollecTRI or normalized prior_grn, applying wrapper validation, and dropping TFs with fewer than min_targets distinct targets.
